metadata.title: कोया आदिवासी का अस्तित्व बनाम पोलावरम परियोजना | Polavaram Project: Displacing the Koya Tribe
metadata.description: The Polavaram irrigation project, a multi-purpose initiative to address water scarcity and generate hydropower, is poised to submerge vast areas across several states, including Odisha. This ground report focuses on Malkangiri district, where the project threatens the lives, livelihoods, and cultural heritage of thousands of tribal communities. The report delves into the scale of displacement as the rising backwaters of the Polavaram dam are set to submerge fertile lands, forests, and homes of tribal families in Malkangiri. Many tribals lack formal land titles, leaving them ineligible for compensation. Interviews with tribals, activists, and local leaders reveal concerns over inadequate rehabilitation and resettlement plans. The report also captures grassroots resistance movements that demand justice and an inclusive developmental approach.
